The object ID should start with "OBJ" and be followed by exactly three digits.  
Example: "OBJ768"

Please note that the object chosen for the project must be unique 
at the object level, not just by color or minor variations.
Guys Please Read the Announcement carefully, and Update the Object_ID's accordingly.
Follow Sequence of Numbers for Object_ID's while registering it here, so its easier to Navigate.
